intro: Built on free and open-source software only (no paid packs or plans). Full license texts ship with the code where noted.

items.blurb: 3D engine behind the Studio office and the Crew character viewer. Vendored with its license in vendor/three/.
items.name: Three.js

items.blurb: Crew avatars and office furniture. Public-domain dedication, no attribution required (credited here anyway).
items.name: Kenney Mini Characters 1.0 + Furniture Kit 2.0

items.blurb: Knowledge-graph index behind the PC search (one index per PC and embedding profile). Installed from requirements.txt; CPU-only.
items.name: LightRAG

items.blurb: Local embedding model for the LightRAG index (384-dim vectors, CPU). The Jetson profile serves BAAI/bge-m3 over LAN instead.
items.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (sentence-transformers 6.2.0)

items.blurb: PDF text/image extraction for handbook uploads (Crew training) and order intake (consultation PDFs). Its pdfminer.six/Pillow dependencies arrive with it; everything else is the Python standard library. Tavily web search uses stdlib urllib (no package).
items.name: pdfplumber

items.blurb: The backend is stdlib-only: HTTP serving and the JSON API run with no framework.
items.name: Python 3.11 Standard Library

items.blurb: Playwright + Chromium drive the automated browser checks. Never bundled, never required to run the app.
items.name: Verification only (not shipped)
